summary:
Autodesk最新季度財報營收與每股盈餘雙雙優於市場預期，展現強健的業務成長動能。
• 營收達到 20.5 億美元，年增率達 16.05%。
• 每股盈餘實際值為 3.30 美元，優於市場預期的 3.12 美元。
• 營運展現韌性，核心軟體與訂閱模式持續貢獻穩定現金流。
ai_view:
觀點：財報表現穩健擊敗預期，釋出基本面正向訊號。中短期內有利於支撐股價評價，但須持續追蹤總體經濟環境對軟體需求之影響、自由現金流成長率以及訂閱續約率等指標。

需留意：總體經濟環境不確定性可能影響企業客戶的 IT 支出預算。；高估值水準（Trailing PE 27.54）對於市場情緒變動較為敏感。

summary_en:
Autodesk reported better-than-expected quarterly revenue and EPS, demonstrating robust business growth momentum.
• Revenue reached $2.05 billion, representing a 16.05% year-over-year increase.
• EPS came in at $3.30, beating the consensus estimate of $3.12.
• Operations demonstrated resilience with core software and subscription models driving steady cash flows.

ai_view_en:
view: Solid earnings beating expectations signal strong fundamentals. This supports near-to-mid term valuation, but key tracking metrics include macroeconomic impacts on software demand, free cash flow growth rates, and subscription renewal metrics.

Watch：Macroeconomic uncertainty could impact enterprise IT spending budgets.; High valuation levels (Trailing PE of 27.54) make the stock sensitive to shifts in market sentiment.
beat_or_miss: 超預期：每股盈餘 3.30 美元高於預估的 3.12 美元，營收亦達 20.5 億美元。
